I lowered `TRACKING_BATCH_SIZE` in `lib/tracking.js` from 100 to 25. I also added a comment saying the carrier's endpoint times out above 25 numbers per request. The change is uncommitted.

All 30 tests pass. The existing batching test uses the constant rather than a hard-coded number, so it follows the new value. I haven't run the nightly refresh against the real carrier.

I also saved the reason for the limit to the repo's Factloom memory.
